# KwikInvoice

> KwikInvoice is a free mobile invoicing app for freelancers and small businesses in South Africa. Create professional PDF invoices in seconds from your Android phone — works completely offline.

KwikInvoice is built by LoggedOn, a South African software company. It is available on the Google Play Store and launched on 27 March 2026.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://kwikinvoice.app/): Overview of KwikInvoice and download links
- [Features](https://kwikinvoice.app/features/): Complete feature list including PDF generation, client management, payment tracking, and offline mode
- [Pricing](https://kwikinvoice.app/pricing/): Free tier and Pro tier details
- [About](https://kwikinvoice.app/about/): Company mission and background

## Product Details

KwikInvoice is an Android-native invoicing application designed specifically for the South African market.

### Target Audience

- Freelancers and independent contractors
- Small business owners and sole proprietors
- Service providers and consultants
- South African entrepreneurs needing fast, simple invoicing

### Core Features

- **Instant PDF Generation**: Professional PDF invoices generated in under 200ms
- **Offline-First**: Full functionality without internet — create, manage, and export invoices offline with auto-sync when online
- **Client Management**: Save and reuse client profiles, import from phone contacts, view complete invoice history per client
- **Payment Tracking**: Mark invoices as paid, pending, or overdue with a revenue dashboard overview
- **Multi-Currency**: Supports ZAR, USD, EUR, GBP, and other major currencies with proper formatting
- **Privacy-First**: Data stored locally on device, no behaviour tracking, no data selling

### Pricing

- **Free**: R0/month — 5 invoices per month, PDF generation, client management, offline mode. No credit card required.
- **Pro**: R79/month or R699/year (save 26%) — Unlimited invoices, cloud backup, advanced reporting, priority support.

### Platform

- Android (Google Play Store)
- Optimized for low-end devices
- Works on Android 8.0 and above
- Built with React Native and Expo

## What Makes KwikInvoice Different

1. Fastest mobile invoice generation (under 200ms)
2. True offline capability — no internet dependency
3. Built specifically for South African freelancers and small businesses
4. Free tier generous enough for micro-businesses
5. Mobile-first design — no desktop app needed
6. Privacy-focused with local-first data storage
